card.name: Verb go/went before "on to"
card.fires_on: Forms of the verb "go" (goes, went, go) right before "on to" or "further" when a subject continues to a next action or statement. A few cases fire on numbers inside approximate ranges.

modes.label: go/went on to
modes.description: The verb "go" after a subject, introducing a further action or result.
modes.example: He<< goes>> on to report his conclusions concerning the existence

modes.label: went further
modes.description: "went" followed by "further", meaning a subject did more than before.
modes.example: It then<< went>> further by directing the Missile Defense Agency to

modes.label: Numbers in ranges
modes.description: A digit in an approximate size or value, as in a range or measurement.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward "on" (and a few other short continuations), and away from unrelated rare tokens.
card.plain: It spots the verb "go" or "went" when the text is about to say "went on to..." and someone continues to a further step.
